title: Taupo Hot Pools Guide for Families — AC Baths vs Thermal Explorer Highway
meta_desc: Discover the best Taupo hot pools for families, including prices and facilities
intro: Taupo is a haven for families seeking a relaxing soak in natural hot pools. With numerous options to choose from, it can be daunting to decide which one suits your family's needs. The AC Baths and Thermal Explorer Highway are two popular choices, but what sets them apart?

sections.heading: AC Baths
sections.body: The AC Baths are a popular choice among families, offering a range of pools and water activities. The complex features a large pool, a learners' pool, a toddler's pool, and two hydroslides. Prices start from $8 for adults and $6 for children (5-15 years), with family passes available for $30.

sections.heading: Thermal Explorer Highway
list: Craters of the Moon: $8 adult, $5 child (5-15 years)

rows: Pools, cave, walking trails, picnic area

sections.heading: Free Hot Pools in Taupo
sections.body: For those on a tight budget, there are a few free hot pool options in Taupo. The Otumuheke Stream is a popular choice, located about 10 minutes' drive from the town centre. However, be aware that the stream can be crowded and the water quality may vary.

sections.heading: Drive Times and Directions
list: AC Baths: 5 minutes from Taupo town centre
Wairakei Terraces: 10 minutes from Taupo town centre
Craters of the Moon: 15 minutes from Taupo town centre
Orakei Korako: 20 minutes from Taupo town centre

sections.heading: Accommodation Options
sections.body: Taupo offers a range of accommodation options, from budget-friendly motels to luxury hotels. Consider booking a campervan or motorhome for a more flexible and affordable option. Check out our campervan guide for more information.
